OD-B22-S01-T01.line: Now for another mark, one no man here has hit.
OD-B22-S01-T01.direction: strips the rags, leaps to the threshold, pours the arrows at his feet

OD-B22-S01-T02.direction: draws to the ear and looses at the throat

OD-B22-S01-T03.direction: cup falls, blood at the nostrils, table kicked over

OD-B22-S01-T04.line: Stranger, you shoot at men! Where are the shields? Where are the spears?
OD-B22-S01-T04.direction: scramble along bare walls and find nothing

OD-B22-S01-T05.line: You dogs. You never thought I would come home from Troy. You ate my house, you forced my women, you courted my wife while I still lived.
OD-B22-S01-T05.direction: holds the threshold, arrow nocked, voice level

OD-B22-S02-T01.line: Antinous is dead, and he was the cause of all of it. Take back the worth of everything we ate, and twenty oxen from each man besides.

OD-B22-S02-T02.line: Eurymachus, if you gave me all your fathers' wealth, my hands would not stop. Fight or run. Not one of you goes out of this door alive.

OD-B22-S02-T03.line: Draw your swords! Hold the tables against his arrows and rush him, and someone raise the town!
OD-B22-S02-T03.direction: lifts a table as a shield and charges

OD-B22-S02-T04.direction: arrow through the chest; the man falls doubled over the table

OD-B22-S02-T05.direction: charges Odysseus and takes a spear from behind

OD-B22-S03-T01.line: Father, I will bring arms. Four shields, four helmets, eight spears, for us and the two herdsmen.
OD-B22-S03-T01.direction: runs to the storeroom and back, arming each man

OD-B22-S03-T02.line: Father, the fault is mine. I left the storeroom door standing open. Their watchman was quicker than I was.
OD-B22-S03-T02.direction: sets the last helmet down and faces him

OD-B22-S03-T03.line: Four men stood armed at the threshold now, and while the arrows lasted the master kept shooting, and man after man went down in the dust.
OD-B22-S03-T03.direction: to the audience, plain and steady

OD-B22-S03-T04.line: When the last arrow was gone he leaned the bow against the doorpost, slung the shield on his shoulder, and took up two spears of bronze.
OD-B22-S03-T04.direction: to the audience, marking the turn to close work

OD-B22-S04-T01.line: Take heart. There is a way up to the storeroom. Twelve shields, twelve spears, twelve helmets, and I will bring them down.
OD-B22-S04-T01.direction: slips through the side passage with an armful of bronze

OD-B22-S04-T02.line: Eumaeus, Philoetius. Someone is arming them out of my own storeroom. Go up, find him, and bring me his hands tied behind his back.
OD-B22-S04-T02.direction: spear steady on the hall, eyes on the side door

OD-B22-S04-T03.direction: seize Melanthius by the hair as he reaches for a helmet

OD-B22-S04-T04.line: Lie up there, Melanthius, and keep your soft bed. You will see the dawn before any man in this house.
OD-B22-S04-T04.direction: hands and feet bound, hauled by rope to the roof beam

OD-B22-S05-T01.line: Odysseus, I have not forgotten you.
OD-B22-S05-T01.direction: enters at the door in Mentor's shape

OD-B22-S05-T02.line: Mentor, keep ruin off me. Remember the friend who honored you all his life. Or have you come late on purpose, now the work is nearly done?
OD-B22-S05-T02.direction: half a glance sideways, spear never dropping

OD-B22-S05-T03.line: Then watch me, Mentor. The man who fought nine years under Troy is still standing in this doorway.
OD-B22-S05-T03.direction: steps down into the hall, spear leveled

OD-B22-S05-T04.line: Six spears the suitors hurled together at the threshold, and every one of them was thrown to kill.
OD-B22-S05-T04.direction: to the audience, the volley in the air

OD-B22-S05-T05.direction: turns the spears aside into doorpost and wall

OD-B22-S05-T06.line: Then the four cast as one, and four men fell, and the hall filled with the noise of the dying.
OD-B22-S05-T06.direction: to the audience, counting the fallen

OD-B22-S05-T07.direction: raises the aegis from the roof beam; the suitors stampede like driven cattle

OD-B22-S06-T01.direction: drives them down the hall like falcons among small birds

OD-B22-S06-T02.line: You were their diviner, Leiodes, and you prayed often enough for my wife's hand. There is no mercy in me for that.
OD-B22-S06-T02.direction: strikes as the man clasps his knees

OD-B22-S06-T03.line: Spare me, Odysseus, and pity me. No man taught me my songs but a god, and I came into this hall under force, not for love of them.
OD-B22-S06-T03.direction: kneels holding the lyre up between them

OD-B22-S06-T04.line: Live, both of you. My son has spoken for you. Go out to the courtyard and sit by the altar until this work is finished.
OD-B22-S06-T04.direction: points them past the threshold with the spear

OD-B22-S06-T05.line: They searched the hall for any man still breathing, and found them all fallen in blood and dust, like fish poured out upon the sand.
OD-B22-S06-T05.direction: to the audience, walking the ruin

OD-B22-S07-T01.line: Twelve of you went the shameless way. You lay with them, and you laughed at me, and you laughed at your queen. Stand out from the others; he knows your names now.
OD-B22-S07-T01.direction: separates twelve women from the rest

OD-B22-S07-T02.line: The women carried the bodies out under the porch, and scoured the tables and the floor with water and sponges until the hall was clean.

OD-B22-S07-T03.line: No clean death for them, not by my sword. They poured shame on my head and on my mother's while she lay alone.
OD-B22-S07-T03.direction: runs a cable from the pillar to the round house

OD-B22-S07-T04.line: They brought Melanthius down into the court and cut him apart, and gave what was left to the dogs.
OD-B22-S07-T04.direction: to the audience, flat, no relish

OD-B22-S07-T05.line: So the house was emptied of its false servants, and everything that had rotted inside it was carried out into the light.
OD-B22-S07-T05.direction: to the audience, closing the account

OD-B22-S08-T01.line: Rejoice in your heart, old woman, but not aloud. It is not holy to crow over dead men. Bring me fire and sulphur now, and I will cleanse this hall.
OD-B22-S08-T01.direction: checks her cry of triumph with a raised hand

OD-B22-S08-T02.direction: crowd in with torches, weeping, kissing his hands

OD-B22-S08-T03.line: Gently now. The doors stay shut until I say otherwise.
OD-B22-S08-T03.direction: holds each of them briefly, eyes on the entrances

OD-B22-S08-T04.line: Go up now and wake your mistress. Tell her the man she waited for is standing in his own hall.
